signIn.title: Sign in to GuGu Studio
signIn.subtitle: For salon owners and staff. Enter your email and GuGu Studio will send a sign-in link — no password needed.
signIn.noAccount: Staff sign in with the email their salon added.
signIn.forSalons: No salon on GuGu Studio yet?

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We just sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. It works for 15 minutes.
checkInbox.codeLabel: Or enter the 6-digit code from the email

verify.failedBody: It has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

errors.wrongCode: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

join.title: Set up your salon in GuGu Studio
join.subtitle: A few basics are enough to start managing appointments. You can edit everything later.
join.emailHint: We'll send a confirmation link to this email.
join.doneBody: Your salon is a draft for now. Next: add services and staff.
join.doneCheckInbox: Open the link we sent to {{email}} to confirm and manage your salon.
join.invalidPhone: That phone number doesn't look right.
join.doneSignInLater: You've requested several emails in a short time. Sign in with {{email}} a little later and confirm the salon to manage it.

pendingSalons.title: Confirm your salons
pendingSalons.body: These salons were registered with your email. Only confirm the ones you created yourself.
